name: PSAC Cross Country Championships
headline: PSAC Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Shippensburg won the men’s title with 53 points over West Chester (67), and East Stroudsburg edged West Chester 65-70 for the women’s, with Edinboro third at 72. West Chester swept the individual titles through Matthew Remishofski (24:54.3) and Kristina Tapia (21:35.1).
